headline: Is AIG’s Underwriting Strength Versus Softer Investment Income Altering The Investment Case For American International Group (AIG)?
summary: American International Group, Inc. recently reported its second-quarter 2026 results, following expectations for higher premiums and revenues but with pressure from weaker net investment income. This mix of healthier underwriting performance and investment income headwinds has sharpened investor focus on the quality and sustainability of AIG's earnings profile. We'll now examine how concerns over softer net investment income ahead of the earnings release may influence AIG's broader...
